response: ["Surgical excision with histologically negative margins is the recommended and first‑line treatment for primary cutaneous melanoma of any thickness and for melanoma in situ.", "Surgical margins for melanoma should be determined based on tumor thickness.", "Sentinel lymph node biopsy, when indicated, should be performed before wide excision of the primary tumor and, whenever possible, in the same operative setting.", "When melanoma is suspected, the entire lesion should be completely excised with a narrow (1–3 mm) margin to allow histological diagnosis.", "Incisional biopsies may be performed on large lesions such as facial lesions (e.g., lentigo maligna), acral lesions, and genital lesions.", "The recommendation that the whole lesion be excised with a narrow margin has a consensus rate of 100 % (21/21)."]
